properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA family (incl. SHA-1) availability via hash.js@1.1.7 — dependency in the lockfile; hash.js exposes sha1/sha256 variants to the app and its transitive deps.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 (Bitcoin/Ethereum curve) support via tiny-secp256k1 ^1.1.7, secp256k1 ^4.0.x and @types/secp256k1 — the multi-coin wallet signs BTC/ETH-style transactions with ECDSA on secp256k1.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 MAC ships via @stablelib/poly1305 and @stablelib/chacha20poly1305 under the Beacon SDK packages (@airgap/beacon-core/-utils) — the AEAD authenticator for the wallet↔dApp P2P channel.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey (OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey, single-round MD5) is shipped in the dependency tree via the browserify-style crypto polyfill chain (pbkdf2/browserify-aes family). Available in the shipped library; no call site found in the application's own code — but presence is what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt-pbkdf ^1.0.0 — OpenBSD-style bcrypt KDF (cross-platform port) as a transitive dependency; password hashing / KDF availability in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk15on:1.70 (android/app/build.gradle:83) is the Java crypto provider shipped in the Android app; the dep_scan attributes RSA among the algorithms it provides. No RSA call site found in app code — the live use of this provider is Ed25519 signature verification in the IsolatedModules plugin. Same dependency as the library record LIB-e95f8318.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.8.1 ships secp256k1 (ECDSA over secp256k1) for the wallet's Bitcoin/Ethereum/Rootstock support (Tezos tz2 accounts); consumed via @airgap packages, no direct import in app source. Quantum-unsafe signature scheme — deadline risk, migrate on a schedule to ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 key agreement ships via @stablelib/x25519 ^2.0.1 and @stablelib/x25519-session (nested under @airgap/beacon-core and @airgap/beacon-utils). This is the wallet↔dApp P2P channel crypto of the Beacon SDK — harvest-now-decrypt-later relevant; no PQ hybrid offered.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature verification of dynamic protocol modules (Android isolated-modules plugin, BouncyCastle Ed25519Signer) plus the @stablelib/ed25519 and bip32-ed25519 dependency declarations. Every one of the 11 sites was individually confirmed; this object-level verdict matches them.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh ^4.0.0 — Node-style ECDH key agreement available in the build (transitive dependency); classical key agreement, Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.8.1 ships Ed25519 — the Tezos tz1 account signature scheme, used through the @airgap/coinlib-core wrapper for transaction/message signing. No direct import in app source; the live BouncyCastle Ed25519 verification in the Android plugin is covered separately (ALG-5e08bdf5, shard 1).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.6.1 (a DIRECT dependency, package.json:235) provides ECDSA — the secp256k1 signature path for Bitcoin/Ethereum stacks pulled in by @airgap packages. Also recorded as the library object LIB-a0bfbc1a.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (secp256r1) via @noble/curves@1.8.1 — NIST curve available in the build for ECDH/ECDSA paths; classical, Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 provides X25519 scalar multiplication — the key agreement behind the Beacon SDK's P2P encrypted channel between wallet and dApps (harvest-now-decrypt-later relevant: recorded wallet↔dApp traffic becomes readable once a CRQC exists). Consumed via @airgap/beacon-sdk.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2 ^3.1.3 is a DIRECT dependency (package.json:232) plus several transitive copies in the lockfile; the app's own source never imports it — it is consumed inside the @airgap/* crypto stacks (key derivation from mnemonics/passwords for the wallet's protocols).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak and @ethersproject/keccak256 ship Keccak-256, the Ethereum address/transaction hash — provided by the dependency tree for the wallet's Ethereum support. Available in the shipped libraries; no direct call site found in the application's own code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt password KDF via scrypt-js ^3.0.0 — dependency in the lockfile; scrypt is used in this ecosystem for seed/mnemonic stretching.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES availability via BouncyCastle bcprov-jdk15on@1.70 (Android Gradle) and the npm dependency tree; both sites individually confirmed, symmetric cipher — quantum-safe rating good, AES-128 default noted by the roster.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @stablelib/hkdf 1.0.1 is a dependency of the @stablelib session/crypto packages backing the wallet's dApp (Beacon) P2P communication. Available in the shipped library; no direct call site found in the application's own code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 via @noble/hashes@1.7.1 — general-purpose digest dependency; used across the wallet's hashing paths.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.7.1 ships BLAKE3 — quantum-safe hash; available in the shipped library, consumed via @airgap packages.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes@1.7.1 ships SHA-3 — quantum-safe hash; available in the shipped library, consumed via @airgap packages. Distinct from the keccak/@ethersproject/keccak256 entries (ALG-052c24b2), already confirmed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-GCM via @noble/ciphers@1.2.1 — authenticated encryption available in the build; symmetric, not Shor-relevant, quantum-safe rating good.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD via @stablelib/chacha20poly1305 (1.0.1 under Beacon SDK) — P2P channel encryption; symmetric, quantum-safe AEAD.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD also available via @noble/ciphers@1.2.1 — quantum-safe symmetric AEAD in the dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305) is the symmetric authenticated encryption of the Beacon P2P transport, applied after X25519 key agreement; quantum-safe symmetric primitives (256-bit), the PQ exposure is the X25519 agreement, not this.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Cloud KMS client (@azure/keyvault-secrets ^4.7.0) present in the dependency tree — key-management infrastructure reference. The app itself is an offline wallet; this client is likely dev/CI tooling. Observable here; which algorithms the vault service supports is decided by the Azure account, not this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl is in the dependency tree — provides X25519 key agreement (nacl.box), XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox and Ed25519 signing; all classical primitives reachable by the app and its Beacon/coinlib deps.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes is the hash provider consumed through the @airgap/* crypto layer (blake2b, SHA-3, BLAKE3, ripemd etc.); transitive dependency per package.json/lockfile — no direct import in app source, but the shipped bundle includes it via the @airgap stacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves (1.8.1) — elliptic-curve library shipping secp256k1/P-256/ed25519/x25519 etc.; the version decides which curve implementations the build carries.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/ciphers (1.2.1) — symmetric cipher library shipping AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, Salsa etc.; the version decides the app's symmetric crypto capability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge is a transitive dependency (not in package.json) reached via the lockfile, pulled in by the selfsigned/dev-tooling chain; it ships TLS/PKI/X.509/RSA implementations in JS. Available in the shipped tree; no call site found in the application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Self-signed X.509 certificate generation via selfsigned@2.1.1 — dependency (dev/test TLS material generator); PKI tooling in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 / PKI handling via node-forge@1.4.0 — dependency carrying certificate parsing/generation and RSA/TLS-era primitives into the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BouncyCastle Java (bcprov-jdk15on 1.70) is the Android app's crypto provider — used directly in IsolatedModules.kt (Ed25519Signer). Version 1.70 predates ML-KEM/ML-DSA support; the provider decides PQ capability on this platform.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 — memory-hard KDF, transitive dependency; the classic Ethereum keystore (secret storage) decryption path in the @airgap/ethereum stack. Available in the shipped library; no direct call site in app source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.12 — streaming SHA-1/SHA-256 implementation as a transitive dependency (old version, pre-2.0.9 era); carries SHA-1 availability into the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.6.1 is a DIRECT dependency (package.json:235) providing ECDSA/secp256k1 — the Bitcoin/Ethereum signing path behind @airgap packages. Same logical asset as ALG-710f61f0 (ECDSA via elliptic@6.6.1).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: selfsigned@2.1.1 generates self-signed X.509 certificates (uses node-forge); transitive lockfile entry — test/dev tooling for the HTTPS/local-server chain rather than production wallet crypto. Presence recorded as the dependency inventory requires.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 — legacy multi-hash JS library (sha256/ripemd160/keccak etc.), transitive dependency of elliptic; available in the shipped library, no direct call site in app source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The pbkdf2 npm package is the PBKDF2 implementation in the tree — same logical asset as ALG-4de3b020 (which carries the full site list including the direct package.json:232 declaration).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Standard Android debug keystore (build output, not source) — signs debug APKs only; the well-known androiddebugkey material. Not production signing material, but it is key material on disk and belongs in the inventory.
